Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/46639

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
Whether or not the `/upgrade/start` request for the old TiDB is received determines whether user DDL needs to be paused during the upgrade.

issue_context.title: Adjust the compatible behavior of this feature
issue_context.body:
* version < v7.4.0, we don't support upgrading TiDB without manually Canceling DDL
* version >= v7.4.0, check whether the client sends `/upgrade/start` API requests
  * If send the `/upgrade/start`, we support upgrading TiDB without manually Canceling DDL.
  * If don't send the `/upgrade/start`, we don't support upgrading TiDB without manually Canceling DDL.

Related PR：https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/46275
